---
title: "wrapped fixture: fig-column margin under column classes"
filters:
  - wrapped
fig-column: margin
format:
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
---

With `fig-column: margin` in the document, Quarto reads a float's own
`fig-column-*` class first, then the document's `fig-column`, and only then
its own `column-*` class. So in PDF a `fig-column-body` float sits in the
body, and a `column-body` float sits in the margin.
